newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 21.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
* Seven Mexican immigrants were arrested on charges of running a smuggling ring that sneaked scores of deaf Mexicans across the border and forced them to work as trinket vendors.

* In Mexico City, news of the seven arrests aroused alarm, confirming rumors of ill treatment suffered by the thousands of deaf Mexicans who travel to the U.S. each year to sell trinkets on the streets.
* Relief is in sight for elderly people who have been forced to pay a share of the bills for hospital outpatient services.
* With juvenile courts in chaos, critics propose trying most minors as adults.
* The International Monetary Fund has for the first time used emergency procedures to arrange a $1 billion loan to the Philippines.
* Belfast residents found a cautious sense of relief under the new IRA truce.
